decision_rationale: Primary model paper on genomic variant interpretation, but the candidate model is a genomic language model over nucleotide sequences rather than a natural-language text-bio model. The provided evidence shows masked language modeling on genomes and variant-position embeddings, with no substantive text component or text-bio bridge.
